snippet.title: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat - Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist "Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat": https://store.steampowered.com/app/4176640/Monster_Retreat

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/monsterprom
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/btflglitch/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@btflglitch/
Twitter / X: https://x.com/monsterprom

Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too 😉

Vocals by Cristina "Vee" Valenzuela and Christine Marie Cabanos
